m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: You can see the Iron Gates are closed. That is normal, but the troop concentration is very high. :Tsssk:
:Tsssk: There is a peculiar feeling in the air. It tastes hot, acrid. The Shadow is suffocating them.
Zha-Te-:Ke:-Zang-Zeeyun - Sardonyx, if you prefer - has always been ruled equally by the Troika. :Tsssk:
One member is a representative of the honorable warrior-sisters, the hunters, like myself.
One is a leader of the savvy and well-traveled trader-sisters, or merchants.
If Zelda the PhantomKnight was demoted, as you said, this bodes ill.
This area is taken up by estates of the old families and-
Halt! You there! Warlord Balor orders you to come with us, or you'll face our spears!
You have no idea who we are, do you?
Let us move away quickly before more guards come.
This is my family estate. It is hard to be back here, after all I've seen in the world.
Leave me be for a bit. Go back to Ezekiel, while I see what I can find out.
I'm sure much has changed for Zarozinia. And as a young nymph, she would have bought fully into the Shadow Queen's rule.
It is easier to show you around than for me to explain it all! Spellbinder, can you take Zarozinia to see her family home?
We will take a quick tour through the city. I need to see what has changed.
Go with Zarozinia the DeathSong to her family estate.
